power: Make PowerStatus include info about all ports. powerd's PowerStatus struct formerly contained information only about ports that had power sources connected to them since that was all that was needed by the UI. To make it easier to add metrics about which ports are connected and disconnected in a future change, collect information about all ports instead. The PowerSupplyProperties protobufs that are sent to Chrome and the power_supply_info helper program continue to only include information about ports with connected power sources. instalog: buffer_simple_file: fix tell() in append mode POSIX spec defines O_APPEND as: "If set, the file offset shall be set to the end of the file prior to each write." Thus if we access tell() right after opening a file in append mode, we are not guaranteed that the offset will be at EOF. On certain machines we get 0; on others we get the EOF position. The solution is to manually seek to the end of the file right after opening the append-mode file handle: with open('/tmp/test', 'w') as f: f.write('hello') with open('/tmp/test', 'a') as f: f.tell() # May return either 0 or 5 f.seek(0, 2) # Seek manually to end of file f.tell() # Guaranteed to return either 5 BUG=None TEST=Manually on local machine Change-Id: I1cdcf69ee28f90d71b9d90cc4ec7bee0a8f18960 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/426304 Commit-Ready: Joel Kitching <kitching@chromium.org> Tested-by: Joel Kitching <kitching@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Chun-Tsen Kuo <chuntsen@chromium.org>
